title: Rig pose helpers (lean, hip hinge, whole-body tilt, foot IK, bone turns)
summary: Post-clip pose tools for recon figures: lean (spine), hinge (bend at the hips), tilt (whole-body diagonal), footTo (2-bone leg IK, returns the miss), turn/aim, bodyOf, a once-only bone log.

versions.note: seed harvest of the shot-match scenes (L3)

usage.import: import { hinge, lean, tilt, footTo, turn, bodyOf } from '../library/module.recon.rig-pose/index.js';

doc.when: Any reference pose no clip matches: a bend at the hips (hinge, not lean), a straight heel-to-head push (tilt), a foot on a rope/rung/step (footTo), twists of a prone or kneeling body (turn).
doc.avoid: Calling them before the clip in a tick (the clip overwrites them). Using lean() alone for a bow: it hunches.
gotchas: Order per tick: f.act/play(...).apply() -> hinge/lean/turn/footTo -> f.handTo().
footTo straightens the leg silently when the target is out of reach: check its return value (miss > .03 m = move the target or the body).
tilt() changes the group transform: call it once in build, not per tick.
A bend away from the camera barely shows (foreshortening): turn the figure partly side-on.
Probe first: the proof scene with ?probe=ClipA,ClipB&pry=1.57&pstep=.3 renders each clip at 6 times from the shot's side in one render.
boneLog only prints with ?bones=1 and only once (tick loggers flood CHECK runs).

params.hinge(f, a): pelvis forward a, thighs back a
params.tilt(f, a, back=.25): whole body, pivot back*a behind the origin
